DEGREE PROGRAMS

Widget Design (BWID)
The Widget Design program is a four-year program.

Freshman Year, Fall Semester (total credits 12)
   • WDGT1000, Introduction to Widget Design
   • MATH1000, College Mathematics I
   • ENGLISH, English Sequence, See ENGL/HSS note below *

Freshman Year, Spring Semester (total credits 12)
   • WDGT1050, Widget Design II
   • WDGT1500, Widget Studio OR
     WDGT1600, Gadget Studio
   • HSS ELECTIVE, See ENGL/HSS note below *
                                                   133
Sophomore Year, Summer Semester (total credits 0)
   • COOP3000, Pre-Cooperative Work Term (Optional)

* ENGL/HSS Note:
Day program students are required to complete:
       •     At least one course in Humanities
   • WDGT2500, Widget Theory

Gadget Studies (BGAD)
Freshman Year, Fall Semester (total credits 8)
GADG1000                 Gadgets I (4 credits)
EC                       Gadget Concentration (4 credits)

Freshman Year, Spring Semester (total credits 8)
GADG1050                 Gadgets II (4 credits)
NOTE: Students take one more course this term.
GADG1100                 Gadgets Lab (4 credits)

Sophomore Year, Fall Semester (total credits 4)
GADG2000                 Gadgets III (4 credits)

Sprocket Studies (BSPR)
Freshman Year, Fall Semester (total credits 9)
SPRK1000                 Sprockets I (4 credits)
SPRK1100                 Sprocket Lab (4 credits)

Sprocket Studies - Chains Concentration
Freshman Year, Spring Semester (total credits 4)
SPRK1500                 Chains (4 credits)

Master of Doohickeys (Two-Year)
First Year, Fall Semester (total credits 9)
DOOH7000                 Doohickey Theory (4 credits)
DOOH7100                 Doohickey Practice (4 credits)
